title: Awkward Sex And The City with Natalie Wall
author: Kablamo Entertainment
description: New York City's finest storytellers relive their most embarrassing sexual experiences just for your pleasure. Based on the popular touring storytelling show, Awkward Sex And The City is hosted by comedian and storyteller, Natalie Wall, and features guests discussing real stories about their sexual exploits, adventures, discoveries, and revelations. For every hilarious sexual tale, there are gross moments to match and love of everything awkward.
